import Mathlib

structure WeightedGraph where
  adj : Array (Array (Nat × Int))

def WeightedGraph.size (g : WeightedGraph) : Nat :=
  g.adj.size

def WeightedGraph.has_edge (g : WeightedGraph) (u v : Nat) (w : Int) : Prop :=
  u < g.size ∧
  ∃ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] ∧ pair.1 = v ∧ pair.2 = w

def WeightedGraph.well_formed (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u, u < g.size →
    -- All targets in range
    (∀ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → pair.1 < g.size) ∧
    -- Unique targets (simple graph)
    (∀ p1 p2, p1 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p2 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p1.1 = p2.1 → p1 = p2)

def WeightedGraph.get_edge_weight (g : WeightedGraph) (_ _ : Nat) : Int :=
  -- Since edges are unique, we can abstractly pick the weight
  -- In specification logic, we can use `Classical.choose` or similar if needed.
  -- But since we pass adjacency list, we can just say "w s.t. has_edge"

def WeightedGraph.is_path (g : WeightedGraph) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
    ∃ w, g.has_edge (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0) w

def WeightedGraph.path_weight (_ : WeightedGraph) (p : List Nat) : Int :=
  match p with
  | [] => 0
  | [_] => 0
  | _ :: _ :: _ =>

      -- For simplicity, we assume `has_edge` defines the unique weight
      -- and we sum it up. However, extracting it in logic is annoying.
      -- Let's define path_weight relationally instead.
      0 

def WeightedGraph.path_has_weight (g : WeightedGraph) (p : List Nat) (w_total : Int) : Prop :=
  match p with
  | [] => w_total = 0
  | [_] => w_total = 0
  | u :: v :: rest =>
      ∃ w_edge w_rest,
        g.has_edge u v w_edge ∧
        g.path_has_weight (v :: rest) w_rest ∧
        w_total = w_edge + w_rest

def WeightedGraph.is_shortest_dist (g : WeightedGraph) (start target : Nat) (d : Int) : Prop :=
  (∃ p, g.is_path p ∧ p.head? = some start ∧ p.getLast? = some target ∧ g.path_has_weight p d) ∧
  (∀ p w, g.is_path p → p.head? = some start → p.getLast? = some target → g.path_has_weight p w → w >= d)

def WeightedGraph.weights_non_negative (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u v w, g.has_edge u v w → w >= 0

def WeightedGraph.weights_and_size_bounded (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  g.size ≤ 100000 ∧
  ∀ u v w, g.has_edge u v w → w ≥ -100000 ∧ w ≤ 100000

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def dijkstra_shortest_paths_precond (graph : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  graph.well_formed ∧
  start < graph.size ∧
  graph.weights_non_negative ∧
  graph.weights_and_size_bounded
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
abbrev GWk (g : WeightedGraph) (l : List Nat) : Prop :=
  List.Chain' (fun u v => ∃ w, g.has_edge u v w) l

def gEdgeW (g : WeightedGraph) (u v : Nat) : Int :=
  (((g.adj.getD u #[]).toList.find? (fun p => p.1 = v)).map Prod.snd).getD 0

def gwt (g : WeightedGraph) : List Nat → Int
  | [] => 0
  | [_] => 0
  | u :: v :: rest => gEdgeW g u v + gwt g (v :: rest)

def collect {α β : Type} (f : α → List β) : List α → List β
  | [] => []
  | a :: t => f a ++ collect f t

def enumPaths (g : WeightedGraph) : Nat → List Nat → Nat → Int → List (Nat × Int)
  | 0, _, u, acc => [(u, acc)]
  | fuel + 1, vis, u, acc =>
      (u, acc) :: collect (fun p =>
          if p.1 ∈ u :: vis then [] else enumPaths g fuel (u :: vis) p.1 (acc + p.2))
        ((g.adj.getD u #[]).toList)

def minOpt : List Int → Option Int
  | [] => none
  | x :: xs => some (xs.foldr min x)

def distOf (entries : List (Nat × Int)) (v : Nat) : Option Int :=
  minOpt ((entries.filter (fun p => p.1 = v)).map Prod.snd)

def buildList (f : Nat → Option Int) : Nat → List (Option Int)
  | 0 => []
  | k + 1 => f 0 :: buildList (fun i => f (i + 1)) k
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def dijkstra_shortest_paths (graph : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat)
    (h_precond : dijkstra_shortest_paths_precond graph start) : List (Option Int) :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  buildList (fun v => distOf (enumPaths graph graph.size [] start 0) v) graph.size
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def dijkstra_shortest_paths_postcond (graph : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat)
    (result : List (Option Int))
    (_ : dijkstra_shortest_paths_precond graph start) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  result.length = graph.size ∧
  ∀ v, v < graph.size →
    match result.getD v none with
    | some d => graph.is_shortest_dist start v d
    | none => ¬ ∃ p, graph.is_path p ∧ p.head? = some start ∧ p.getLast? = some v
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
-- basic list helpers

lemma buildList_length (f : Nat → Option Int) (n : Nat) : (buildList f n).length = n := by
  induction n generalizing f with
  | zero => simp [buildList]
  | succ k ih => simp [buildList, ih]

lemma buildList_getD (f : Nat → Option Int) (n : Nat) :
    ∀ v, v < n → (buildList f n).getD v none = f v := by
  induction n generalizing f with
  | zero => intro v hv; exact absurd hv (by omega)
  | succ k ih =>
    intro v hv
    by_cases h0 : v = 0
    · subst h0
      show (f 0 :: buildList (fun i => f (i + 1)) k).getD 0 none = f 0
      simp
    · obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j, v = j + 1 := ⟨v - 1, by omega⟩
      subst hj
      show (f 0 :: buildList (fun i => f (i + 1)) k).getD (j + 1) none = f (j + 1)
      rw [List.getD_cons_succ]
      exact ih (fun i => f (i + 1)) j (by omega)

lemma mem_collect {α β : Type} (f : α → List β) (l : List α) (b : β) :
    b ∈ collect f l ↔ ∃ a ∈ l, b ∈ f a := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [collect]
  | cons a t ih => simp [collect, ih]

lemma glast_cons2 {α : Type} (a b : α) (t : List α) :
    (a :: b :: t).getLast? = (b :: t).getLast? := by
  first
  | rfl
  | simp

lemma getLast?_snoc {α : Type} (l : List α) (a : α) : (l ++ [a]).getLast? = some a := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons b t ih =>
    cases t with
    | nil => simp
    | cons c t' =>
      have e1 : (b :: c :: t') ++ [a] = b :: c :: (t' ++ [a]) := rfl
      have e2 : (c :: t') ++ [a] = c :: (t' ++ [a]) := rfl
      rw [e1, glast_cons2]
      rw [e2] at ih
      exact ih

lemma head?_eq {α : Type} (P : List α) (u : α) (h : P.head? = some u) : ∃ t, P = u :: t := by
  cases P with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons a t =>
    have : a = u := by simpa using h
    exact ⟨t, by rw [this]⟩

lemma snoc_of_getLast? {α : Type} :
    ∀ (l : List α) (u : α), l.getLast? = some u → ∃ A, l = A ++ [u] := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro u h; simp at h
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro u h
    cases t with
    | nil =>
      have hau : a = u := by simpa using h
      exact ⟨[], by simp [hau]⟩
    | cons b t' =>
      rw [glast_cons2] at h
      obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := ih u h
      exact ⟨a :: A, by rw [hA]; rfl⟩

lemma getD_cz (x : Nat) (L : List Nat) : (x :: L).getD 0 0 = x := by
  first | rfl | simp

lemma getD_cs (x : Nat) (L : List Nat) (i : Nat) : (x :: L).getD (i + 1) 0 = L.getD i 0 := by
  first | rfl | simp

lemma arrMem {α : Type} (a : α) (as : Array α) : a ∈ as ↔ a ∈ as.toList := by
  first
  | simp
  | exact Array.mem_def

lemma nodup_length_le (P : List Nat) (n : Nat) (h1 : P.Nodup) (h2 : ∀ x ∈ P, x < n) :
    P.length ≤ n := by
  have hsub : P ⊆ List.range n := fun x hx => List.mem_range.mpr (h2 x hx)
  have h3 : P.length ≤ (List.range n).length :=
    List.Subperm.length_le (List.Nodup.subperm h1 hsub)
  simpa using h3

lemma nodup_snoc (A : List Nat) (v : Nat) (h1 : A.Nodup) (h2 : v ∉ A) : (A ++ [v]).Nodup := by
  induction A with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a t ih =>
    have h3 := List.nodup_cons.mp h1
    have h4 : v ∉ t := fun hc => h2 (List.mem_cons_of_mem a hc)
    have h5 : a ≠ v := fun hc => h2 (by rw [← hc]; simp)
    refine List.nodup_cons.mpr ⟨?_, ih h3.2 h4⟩
    intro hc
    rcases List.mem_append.mp hc with hc1 | hc1
    · exact h3.1 hc1
    · exact h5 (by simpa using hc1)

lemma nodup_split (A : List Nat) (v : Nat) (B : List Nat) (h : (A ++ v :: B).Nodup) :
    A.Nodup ∧ v ∉ A := by
  induction A with
  | nil => exact ⟨List.nodup_nil, by simp⟩
  | cons a t ih =>
    have h1 := List.nodup_cons.mp h
    obtain ⟨h2, h3⟩ := ih h1.2
    refine ⟨List.nodup_cons.mpr ⟨fun hc => h1.1 (List.mem_append.mpr (Or.inl hc)), h2⟩, ?_⟩
    intro hc
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hc with hc1 | hc1
    · exact h1.1 (List.mem_append.mpr (Or.inr (by rw [← hc1]; simp)))
    · exact h3 hc1

-- gwt equations

@[simp] lemma gwt_nil (g : WeightedGraph) : gwt g [] = 0 := by
  first | rfl | simp [gwt]

@[simp] lemma gwt_single (g : WeightedGraph) (a : Nat) : gwt g [a] = 0 := by
  first | rfl | simp [gwt]

@[simp] lemma gwt_cons2 (g : WeightedGraph) (a b : Nat) (t : List Nat) :
    gwt g (a :: b :: t) = gEdgeW g a b + gwt g (b :: t) := by
  first | rfl | simp [gwt]

-- GWk helpers

lemma GWk_nil (g : WeightedGraph) : GWk g [] := List.chain'_nil

lemma GWk_single (g : WeightedGraph) (a : Nat) : GWk g [a] := List.chain'_singleton a

lemma GWk_cons2_iff (g : WeightedGraph) (a b : Nat) (t : List Nat) :
    GWk g (a :: b :: t) ↔ (∃ w, g.has_edge a b w) ∧ GWk g (b :: t) := List.chain'_cons

lemma GWk_append_iff (g : WeightedGraph) (l1 l2 : List Nat) :
    GWk g (l1 ++ l2) ↔
      GWk g l1 ∧ GWk g l2 ∧ ∀ x ∈ l1.getLast?, ∀ y ∈ l2.head?, ∃ w, g.has_edge x y w :=
  List.chain'_append

lemma GWk_trunc (g : WeightedGraph) (A : List Nat) (v : Nat) (B : List Nat)
    (h : GWk g (A ++ v :: B)) : GWk g (A ++ [v]) := by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := (GWk_append_iff g A (v :: B)).mp h
  refine (GWk_append_iff g A [v]).mpr ⟨h1, GWk_single g v, ?_⟩
  intro x hx y hy
  have hyv : v = y := by simpa using hy
  rw [← hyv]
  exact h3 x hx v (by simp)

lemma GWk_snoc (g : WeightedGraph) (P : List Nat) (u v : Nat) (w : Int)
    (hP : GWk g P) (hl : P.getLast? = some u) (he : g.has_edge u v w) : GWk g (P ++ [v]) := by
  refine (GWk_append_iff g P [v]).mpr ⟨hP, GWk_single g v, ?_⟩
  intro x hx y hy
  rw [hl] at hx
  have hxu : u = x := by simpa using hx
  have hyv : v = y := by simpa using hy
  rw [← hxu, ← hyv]
  exact ⟨w, he⟩

-- edge weight facts

lemma hasEdge_iff (g : WeightedGraph) (u v : Nat) (w : Int) (hu : u < g.size) :
    g.has_edge u v w ↔ (v, w) ∈ (g.adj.getD u #[]).toList := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨-, pair, hmem, h1, h2⟩ := h
    have hp : pair = (v, w) := by
      first
      | exact Prod.ext_iff.mpr ⟨h1, h2⟩
      | (cases pair; simp_all)
    rw [← hp]
    exact (arrMem pair _).mp hmem
  · intro h
    exact ⟨hu, (v, w), (arrMem (v, w) _).mpr h, rfl, rfl⟩

lemma edgeW_eq (g : WeightedGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed) (u v : Nat) (w : Int)
    (h : g.has_edge u v w) : gEdgeW g u v = w := by
  obtain ⟨hu, pair, hmem, h1, h2⟩ := h
  have hml : pair ∈ (g.adj.getD u #[]).toList := (arrMem pair _).mp hmem
  unfold gEdgeW
  cases hf : (g.adj.getD u #[]).toList.find? (fun p => p.1 = v) with
  | none =>
    have hcon := List.find?_eq_none.mp hf pair hml
    simp [h1] at hcon
  | some q =>
    have hq1 : q ∈ (g.adj.getD u #[]).toList := List.mem_of_find?_eq_some hf
    have hq2 : q.1 = v := by
      have h3 := List.find?_some hf
      simpa using h3
    have huniq : q = pair :=
      (hwf u hu).2 q pair ((arrMem q _).mpr hq1) hmem (by rw [hq2, h1])
    simp [huniq, h2]

lemma gEdgeW_nonneg (g : WeightedGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed) (hnn : g.weights_non_negative)
    (u v : Nat) (h : ∃ w, g.has_edge u v w) : 0 ≤ gEdgeW g u v := by
  have hnn' : ∀ a b c, g.has_edge a b c → c ≥ 0 := hnn
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := h
  rw [edgeW_eq g hwf u v w hw]
  exact hnn' u v w hw

lemma nodes_lt (g : WeightedGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed) :
    ∀ (P : List Nat) (s : Nat), GWk g P → P.head? = some s → s < g.size →
      ∀ x ∈ P, x < g.size := by
  intro P
  induction P with
  | nil => intro s _ _ _ x hx; simp at hx
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro s hP hh hs x hx
    have ha : a = s := by simpa using hh
    subst ha
    cases t with
    | nil =>
      have hxa : x = a := by simpa using hx
      subst hxa
      exact hs
    | cons b t' =>
      obtain ⟨⟨w, he⟩, hc⟩ := (GWk_cons2_iff g a b t').mp hP
      have hb : b < g.size := by
        obtain ⟨ha', pair, hmem, h1, -⟩ := he
        have h4 := (hwf a ha').1 pair hmem
        rw [h1] at h4
        exact h4
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with h | h
      · subst h; exact hs
      · exact ih b hc (by simp) hb x h

lemma gwt_nonneg (g : WeightedGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed) (hnn : g.weights_non_negative) :
    ∀ P : List Nat, GWk g P → 0 ≤ gwt g P := by
  intro P
  induction P with
  | nil => intro _; simp
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro hP
    cases t with
    | nil => simp
    | cons b t' =>
      obtain ⟨he, hc⟩ := (GWk_cons2_iff g a b t').mp hP
      have h1 := gEdgeW_nonneg g hwf hnn a b he
      have h2 := ih hc
      rw [gwt_cons2]
      linarith

-- path weight bridging

lemma phw_nil (g : WeightedGraph) (d : Int) : g.path_has_weight [] d ↔ d = 0 := by
  first | rfl | simp [WeightedGraph.path_has_weight]

lemma phw_single (g : WeightedGraph) (a : Nat) (d : Int) : g.path_has_weight [a] d ↔ d = 0 := by
  first | rfl | simp [WeightedGraph.path_has_weight]

lemma phw_cons2 (g : WeightedGraph) (a b : Nat) (t : List Nat) (d : Int) :
    g.path_has_weight (a :: b :: t) d ↔
      ∃ we wr, g.has_edge a b we ∧ g.path_has_weight (b :: t) wr ∧ d = we + wr := by
  first | rfl | simp [WeightedGraph.path_has_weight]

lemma phw_of_GWk (g : WeightedGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed) :
    ∀ P : List Nat, GWk g P → g.path_has_weight P (gwt g P) := by
  intro P
  induction P with
  | nil => intro _; rw [phw_nil]; simp
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro hP
    cases t with
    | nil => rw [phw_single]; simp
    | cons b t' =>
      obtain ⟨⟨w, hw⟩, hc⟩ := (GWk_cons2_iff g a b t').mp hP
      rw [phw_cons2]
      refine ⟨gEdgeW g a b, gwt g (b :: t'), ?_, ih hc, ?_⟩
      · have he : gEdgeW g a b = w := edgeW_eq g hwf a b w hw
        rw [he]; exact hw
      · rw [gwt_cons2]

lemma phw_unique (g : WeightedGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed) :
    ∀ (P : List Nat) (d : Int), g.path_has_weight P d → GWk g P ∧ d = gwt g P := by
  intro P
  induction P with
  | nil =>
    intro d h
    rw [phw_nil] at h
    exact ⟨GWk_nil g, by simp [h]⟩
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro d h
    cases t with
    | nil =>
      rw [phw_single] at h
      exact ⟨GWk_single g a, by simp [h]⟩
    | cons b t' =>
      rw [phw_cons2] at h
      obtain ⟨we, wr, he, hr, hd⟩ := h
      obtain ⟨hc, hwr⟩ := ih wr hr
      refine ⟨(GWk_cons2_iff g a b t').mpr ⟨⟨we, he⟩, hc⟩, ?_⟩
      rw [gwt_cons2, edgeW_eq g hwf a b we he, hd, hwr]

lemma isPath_GWk (g : WeightedGraph) : ∀ P : List Nat, g.is_path P → GWk g P := by
  intro P
  induction P with
  | nil => intro _; exact GWk_nil g
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro h
    obtain ⟨hlen, hedge⟩ := h
    cases t with
    | nil => exact GWk_single g a
    | cons b t' =>
      refine (GWk_cons2_iff g a b t').mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · have h0 := hedge 0 (by simp only [List.length_cons]; omega)
        rw [getD_cz, getD_cs, getD_cz] at h0
        exact h0
      · refine ih ⟨by simp, ?_⟩
        intro i hi
        have h1 := hedge (i + 1) (by simp only [List.length_cons] at hi ⊢; omega)
        rw [getD_cs, getD_cs] at h1
        exact h1

lemma GWk_isPath (g : WeightedGraph) : ∀ P : List Nat, GWk g P → P ≠ [] → g.is_path P := by
  intro P
  induction P with
  | nil => intro _ h; exact absurd rfl h
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro hP _
    cases t with
    | nil =>
      refine ⟨by simp, ?_⟩
      intro i hi
      simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_nil] at hi
      omega
    | cons b t' =>
      obtain ⟨⟨w, hw⟩, hc⟩ := (GWk_cons2_iff g a b t').mp hP
      obtain ⟨-, hip2⟩ := ih hc (by simp)
      refine ⟨by simp, ?_⟩
      intro i hi
      by_cases h0 : i = 0
      · subst h0
        rw [getD_cz, getD_cs, getD_cz]
        exact ⟨w, hw⟩
      · obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j, i = j + 1 := ⟨i - 1, by omega⟩
        subst hj
        rw [getD_cs, getD_cs]
        have hi' : j + 1 < (b :: t').length := by
          simp only [List.length_cons] at hi ⊢; omega
        exact hip2 j hi'

-- enumeration equations

lemma enumPaths_zero (g : WeightedGraph) (vis : List Nat) (u : Nat) (acc : Int) :
    enumPaths g 0 vis u acc = [(u, acc)] := by
  first | rfl | simp [enumPaths]

lemma enumPaths_succ (g : WeightedGraph) (fuel : Nat) (vis : List Nat) (u : Nat) (acc : Int) :
    enumPaths g (fuel + 1) vis u acc =
      (u, acc) :: collect (fun p =>
          if p.1 ∈ u :: vis then [] else enumPaths g fuel (u :: vis) p.1 (acc + p.2))
        ((g.adj.getD u #[]).toList) := by
  first | rfl | simp [enumPaths]

lemma enum_complete (g : WeightedGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed) :
    ∀ (fuel : Nat) (P vis : List Nat) (u : Nat) (acc : Int) (v : Nat),
      GWk g P → P.head? = some u → P.Nodup → (∀ x ∈ P, x ∉ vis) →
      P.length ≤ fuel + 1 → P.getLast? = some v →
      (v, acc + gwt g P) ∈ enumPaths g fuel vis u acc := by
  intro fuel
  induction fuel with
  | zero =>
    intro P vis u acc v hW hh hnd hvis hlen hlast
    obtain ⟨t, hPt⟩ := head?_eq P u hh
    subst hPt
    cases t with
    | nil =>
      have hv : u = v := by simpa using hlast
      subst hv
      rw [enumPaths_zero]
      simp
    | cons b t' =>
      simp only [List.length_cons] at hlen
      omega
  | succ fuel ih =>
    intro P vis u acc v hW hh hnd hvis hlen hlast
    obtain ⟨t, hPt⟩ := head?_eq P u hh
    subst hPt
    cases t with
    | nil =>
      have hv : u = v := by simpa using hlast
      subst hv
      rw [enumPaths_succ]
      simp
    | cons b t' =>
      obtain ⟨⟨w, hw⟩, hc⟩ := (GWk_cons2_iff g u b t').mp hW
      have hE : gEdgeW g u b = w := edgeW_eq g hwf u b w hw
      have hnd2 := List.nodup_cons.mp hnd
      have hbne : b ∉ u :: vis := by
        intro hcon
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hcon with h1 | h1
        · exact hnd2.1 (by simp [h1])
        · exact hvis b (by simp) h1
      have hvis2 : ∀ x ∈ (b :: t'), x ∉ u :: vis := by
        intro x hx hcon
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hcon with h1 | h1
        · rw [h1] at hx; exact hnd2.1 hx
        · exact hvis x (List.mem_cons_of_mem u hx) h1
      have hlen2 : (b :: t').length ≤ fuel + 1 := by
        simp only [List.length_cons] at hlen ⊢; omega
      have hlast2 : (b :: t').getLast? = some v := by
        rw [← hlast]

lemma base_sound (g : WeightedGraph) (u : Nat) (vis : List Nat) (acc : Int) (v : Nat) (ω : Int)
    (hvis : u ∉ vis) (hv : v = u) (hω : ω = acc) :
    ∃ P : List Nat, P.head? = some u ∧ P.getLast? = some v ∧ GWk g P ∧ P.Nodup ∧
      (∀ x ∈ P, x ∉ vis) ∧ ω = acc + gwt g P := by
  refine ⟨[u], by simp, by simp [hv], GWk_single g u, by simp, by simpa using hvis, by simp [hω]⟩

lemma enum_sound (g : WeightedGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed) :
    ∀ (fuel : Nat) (vis : List Nat) (u : Nat) (acc : Int) (v : Nat) (ω : Int),
      u < g.size → u ∉ vis → (v, ω) ∈ enumPaths g fuel vis u acc →
      ∃ P : List Nat, P.head? = some u ∧ P.getLast? = some v ∧ GWk g P ∧ P.Nodup ∧
        (∀ x ∈ P, x ∉ vis) ∧ ω = acc + gwt g P := by
  intro fuel
  induction fuel with
  | zero =>
    intro vis u acc v ω hu hvis hmem
    rw [enumPaths_zero] at hmem
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hmem with h | h
    · have hv : v = u := congrArg Prod.fst h
      have hω : ω = acc := congrArg Prod.snd h
      exact base_sound g u vis acc v ω hvis hv hω
    · exact absurd h (by simp)
  | succ fuel ih =>
    intro vis u acc v ω hu hvis hmem
    rw [enumPaths_succ] at hmem
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hmem with h | h
    · have hv : v = u := congrArg Prod.fst h
      have hω : ω = acc := congrArg Prod.snd h
      exact base_sound g u vis acc v ω hvis hv hω
    · rw [mem_collect] at h
      obtain ⟨p, hpL, hpm⟩ := h
      have hpm' : (v, ω) ∈
          (if p.1 ∈ u :: vis then ([] : List (Nat × Int))
            else enumPaths g fuel (u :: vis) p.1 (acc + p.2)) := hpm
      have hpe : g.has_edge u p.1 p.2 := (hasEdge_iff g u p.1 p.2 hu).mpr (by simpa using hpL)
      by_cases hin : p.1 ∈ u :: vis
      · rw [if_pos hin] at hpm'
        simp at hpm'
      · rw [if_neg hin] at hpm'
        have hp1lt : p.1 < g.size := (hwf u hu).1 p ((arrMem p _).mpr hpL)
        obtain ⟨P', hh', hl', hW', hnd', hvis', hω'⟩ :=
          ih (u :: vis) p.1 (acc + p.2) v ω hp1lt hin hpm'
        obtain ⟨t', hP'⟩ := head?_eq P' p.1 hh'
        subst hP'
        refine ⟨u :: p.1 :: t', by simp, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [glast_cons2]; exact hl'
        · exact (GWk_cons2_iff g u p.1 t').mpr ⟨⟨p.2, hpe⟩, hW'⟩
        · refine List.nodup_cons.mpr ⟨?_, hnd'⟩
          intro hcon
          exact hvis' u hcon (by simp)
        · intro x hx
          rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with h1 | h1
          · subst h1; exact hvis
          · intro hcon
            exact hvis' x h1 (by simp [hcon])
        · rw [gwt_cons2, edgeW_eq g hwf u p.1 p.2 hpe, hω']
          ring

-- min facts

lemma foldr_min_mem : ∀ (xs : List Int) (x : Int), xs.foldr min x ∈ x :: xs := by
  intro xs
  induction xs with
  | nil => intro x; simp
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro x
    have h := ih x
    rcases le_total a (t.foldr min x) with hle | hle
    · rw [List.foldr_cons, min_eq_left hle]; simp
    · rw [List.foldr_cons, min_eq_right hle]
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp h with h1 | h1
      · rw [h1]; simp
      · simp [h1]

lemma foldr_min_le : ∀ (xs : List Int) (x y : Int), y ∈ x :: xs → xs.foldr min x ≤ y := by
  intro xs
  induction xs with
  | nil =>
    intro x y hy
    have hyx : y = x := by simpa using hy
    simp [hyx]
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro x y hy
    rw [List.foldr_cons]
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hy with h1 | h1
    · have h2 := ih x x (by simp)
      have h3 : min a (t.foldr min x) ≤ t.foldr min x := min_le_right _ _
      rw [h1]
      linarith
    · rcases List.mem_cons.mp h1 with h2 | h2
      · rw [h2]; exact min_le_left _ _
      · have h3 := ih x y (List.mem_cons_of_mem x h2)
        have h4 : min a (t.foldr min x) ≤ t.foldr min x := min_le_right _ _
        linarith

lemma minOpt_nil : minOpt [] = none := by first | rfl | simp [minOpt]

lemma minOpt_cons (x : Int) (xs : List Int) : minOpt (x :: xs) = some (xs.foldr min x) := by
  first | rfl | simp [minOpt]

lemma minOpt_mem (l : List Int) (d : Int) (h : minOpt l = some d) : d ∈ l := by
  cases l with
  | nil => rw [minOpt_nil] at h; exact absurd h (by simp)
  | cons x xs =>
    rw [minOpt_cons] at h
    have hd : xs.foldr min x = d := by simpa using h
    rw [← hd]
    exact foldr_min_mem xs x

lemma minOpt_le (l : List Int) (x : Int) (h : x ∈ l) : ∃ d, minOpt l = some d ∧ d ≤ x := by
  cases l with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons a t => exact ⟨t.foldr min a, minOpt_cons a t, foldr_min_le t a x h⟩

lemma mem_dl (entries : List (Nat × Int)) (v : Nat) (d : Int) :
    d ∈ (entries.filter (fun p => p.1 = v)).map Prod.snd ↔ (v, d) ∈ entries := by
  simp only [List.mem_map, List.mem_filter, decide_eq_true_eq]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨p, ⟨hp, hp1⟩, hp2⟩
    have hpe : p = (v, d) := by
      first
      | exact Prod.ext_iff.mpr ⟨hp1, hp2⟩
      | (cases p; simp_all)
    rw [← hpe]; exact hp
  · intro h
    exact ⟨(v, d), ⟨h, rfl⟩, rfl⟩

lemma distOf_mem (entries : List (Nat × Int)) (v : Nat) (d : Int)
    (h : distOf entries v = some d) : (v, d) ∈ entries :=
  (mem_dl entries v d).mp (minOpt_mem _ _ h)

lemma distOf_le (entries : List (Nat × Int)) (v : Nat) (ω : Int) (h : (v, ω) ∈ entries) :
    ∃ d, distOf entries v = some d ∧ d ≤ ω := by
  have h1 : ω ∈ (entries.filter (fun p => p.1 = v)).map Prod.snd := (mem_dl entries v ω).mpr h
  obtain ⟨d, hd1, hd2⟩ := minOpt_le _ _ h1
  exact ⟨d, hd1, hd2⟩

-- gwt append facts

lemma gwt_split (g : WeightedGraph) (v : Nat) (B : List Nat) :
    ∀ A : List Nat, gwt g (A ++ v :: B) = gwt g (A ++ [v]) + gwt g (v :: B) := by
  intro A
  induction A with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a A' ih =>
    cases A' with
    | nil =>
      show gwt g (a :: v :: B) = gwt g (a :: [v]) + gwt g (v :: B)
      rw [gwt_cons2, gwt_cons2]
      simp
    | cons a2 A'' =>
      show gwt g (a :: a2 :: (A'' ++ v :: B)) =
        gwt g (a :: a2 :: (A'' ++ [v])) + gwt g (v :: B)
      have ih' : gwt g (a2 :: (A'' ++ v :: B)) =
          gwt g (a2 :: (A'' ++ [v])) + gwt g (v :: B) := ih
      rw [gwt_cons2, gwt_cons2, ih']
      ring

lemma gwt_snoc (g : WeightedGraph) (P : List Nat) (u v : Nat) (h : P.getLast? = some u) :
    gwt g (P ++ [v]) = gwt g P + gEdgeW g u v := by
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := snoc_of_getLast? P u h
  subst hA
  have h1 : (A ++ [u]) ++ [v] = A ++ u :: [v] := by simp
  rw [h1, gwt_split]
  simp

-- distance facts

lemma dist_le_of_path (g : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat) (hwf : g.well_formed)
    (hs : start < g.size) (Q : List Nat) (v : Nat) (hW : GWk g Q)
    (hh : Q.head? = some start) (hl : Q.getLast? = some v) (hnd : Q.Nodup) :
    ∃ d, distOf (enumPaths g g.size [] start 0) v = some d ∧ d ≤ gwt g Q := by
  have hlt : ∀ x ∈ Q, x < g.size := nodes_lt g hwf Q start hW hh hs
  have hlen : Q.length ≤ g.size := nodup_length_le Q g.size hnd hlt
  have hmem := enum_complete g hwf g.size Q [] start 0 v hW hh hnd (by simp) (by omega) hl
  obtain ⟨d, hd1, hd2⟩ := distOf_le _ v (0 + gwt g Q) hmem
  exact ⟨d, hd1, by linarith⟩

lemma dist_edge (g : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat) (hwf : g.well_formed)
    (hnn : g.weights_non_negative) (hs : start < g.size)
    (u v : Nat) (w : Int) (he : g.has_edge u v w) (du : Int)
    (hdu : distOf (enumPaths g g.size [] start 0) u = some du) :
    ∃ dv, distOf (enumPaths g g.size [] start 0) v = some dv ∧ dv ≤ du + w := by
  have hnn' : ∀ a b c, g.has_edge a b c → c ≥ 0 := hnn
  have hw0 : 0 ≤ w := hnn' u v w he
  have hmem := distOf_mem _ u du hdu
  obtain ⟨P, hh, hl, hW, hnd, -, hω⟩ :=
    enum_sound g hwf g.size [] start 0 u du hs (by simp) hmem
  have hdu' : du = gwt g P := by simpa using hω
  by_cases hvP : v ∈ P
  · obtain ⟨A, B, hAB⟩ := List.append_of_mem hvP
    have hWP : GWk g (A ++ v :: B) := by rw [← hAB]; exact hW
    have hWQ : GWk g (A ++ [v]) := GWk_trunc g A v B hWP
    have hWvB : GWk g (v :: B) := ((GWk_append_iff g A (v :: B)).mp hWP).2.1
    have hndAB : (A ++ v :: B).Nodup := by rw [← hAB]; exact hnd
    obtain ⟨hndA, hvA⟩ := nodup_split A v B hndAB
    have hndQ : (A ++ [v]).Nodup := nodup_snoc A v hndA hvA
    have hhQ : (A ++ [v]).head? = some start := by
      rw [hAB] at hh
      cases A with
      | nil => simpa using hh
      | cons a A' => simpa using hh
    have hlQ : (A ++ [v]).getLast? = some v := getLast?_snoc A v
    have hsplit : gwt g P = gwt g (A ++ [v]) + gwt g (v :: B) := by
      rw [hAB]; exact gwt_split g v B A
    have hnonneg : 0 ≤ gwt g (v :: B) := gwt_nonneg g hwf hnn (v :: B) hWvB
    obtain ⟨d, hd1, hd2⟩ := dist_le_of_path g start hwf hs (A ++ [v]) v hWQ hhQ hlQ hndQ
    exact ⟨d, hd1, by linarith⟩
  · have hWQ : GWk g (P ++ [v]) := GWk_snoc g P u v w hW hl he
    have hndQ : (P ++ [v]).Nodup := nodup_snoc P v hnd hvP
    have hhQ : (P ++ [v]).head? = some start := by
      obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := head?_eq P start hh
      rw [ht]; simp
    have hlQ : (P ++ [v]).getLast? = some v := getLast?_snoc P v
    have hwtQ : gwt g (P ++ [v]) = gwt g P + gEdgeW g u v := gwt_snoc g P u v hl
    have hEw : gEdgeW g u v = w := edgeW_eq g hwf u v w he
    obtain ⟨d, hd1, hd2⟩ := dist_le_of_path g start hwf hs (P ++ [v]) v hWQ hhQ hlQ hndQ
    rw [hwtQ, hEw] at hd2
    exact ⟨d, hd1, by linarith⟩

lemma dist_start (g : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat) (hwf : g.well_formed)
    (hs : start < g.size) :
    ∃ d0, distOf (enumPaths g g.size [] start 0) start = some d0 ∧ d0 ≤ 0 := by
  obtain ⟨d, hd1, hd2⟩ :=
    dist_le_of_path g start hwf hs [start] start (GWk_single g start) (by simp) (by simp)
      (by simp)
  exact ⟨d, hd1, by simpa using hd2⟩

lemma propagate (g : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat) (hwf : g.well_formed)
    (hnn : g.weights_non_negative) (hs : start < g.size) :
    ∀ (P : List Nat) (u t : Nat) (du : Int), GWk g P → P.head? = some u →
      P.getLast? = some t → distOf (enumPaths g g.size [] start 0) u = some du →
      ∃ dt, distOf (enumPaths g g.size [] start 0) t = some dt ∧ dt ≤ du + gwt g P := by
  intro P
  induction P with
  | nil => intro u t du _ hh _ _; simp at hh
  | cons a L ih =>
    intro u t du hW hh hl hdu
    have hau : a = u := by simpa using hh
    subst hau
    cases L with
    | nil =>
      have hat : a = t := by simpa using hl
      subst hat
      exact ⟨du, hdu, by simp⟩
    | cons b L' =>
      obtain ⟨⟨w, hw⟩, hc⟩ := (GWk_cons2_iff g a b L').mp hW
      obtain ⟨db, hdb1, hdb2⟩ := dist_edge g start hwf hnn hs a b w hw du hdu
      have hlb : (b :: L').getLast? = some t := by
        rw [← hl]; exact (glast_cons2 a b L').symm
      obtain ⟨dt, hdt1, hdt2⟩ := ih b t db hc (by simp) hlb hdb1
      refine ⟨dt, hdt1, ?_⟩
      have hE : gEdgeW g a b = w := edgeW_eq g hwf a b w hw
      rw [gwt_cons2, hE]
      linarith

        graph.size).getD v none with

  | x :: xs => some (xs.foldr min x)

  minOpt ((entries.filter (fun p => p.1 = v)).map Prod.snd)

def WeightedGraph.path_weight (_ : WeightedGraph) (p : List Nat) : Int :=
  match p with
  | [] => 0
  | [_] => 0
  | _ :: _ :: _ =>
      -- This assumes unique edges logic or we need an explicit path including weights
      -- For simplicity, we assume `has_edge` defines the unique weight
      -- and we sum it up. However, extracting it in logic is annoying.
      -- Let's define path_weight relationally instead.
      0 

def WeightedGraph.path_has_weight (g : WeightedGraph) (p : List Nat) (w_total : Int) : Prop :=
  match p with
  | [] => w_total = 0
  | [_] => w_total = 0
  | u :: v :: rest =>
      ∃ w_edge w_rest,
        g.has_edge u v w_edge ∧
        g.path_has_weight (v :: rest) w_rest ∧
        w_total = w_edge + w_rest

def WeightedGraph.is_shortest_dist (g : WeightedGraph) (start target : Nat) (d : Int) : Prop :=
  (∃ p, g.is_path p ∧ p.head? = some start ∧ p.getLast? = some target ∧ g.path_has_weight p d) ∧
  (∀ p w, g.is_path p → p.head? = some start → p.getLast? = some target → g.path_has_weight p w → w >= d)

def WeightedGraph.weights_non_negative (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u v w, g.has_edge u v w → w >= 0

def WeightedGraph.weights_and_size_bounded (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  g.size ≤ 100000 ∧
  ∀ u v w, g.has_edge u v w → w ≥ -100000 ∧ w ≤ 100000

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def dijkstra_shortest_paths_precond (graph : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  graph.well_formed ∧
  start < graph.size ∧
  graph.weights_non_negative ∧
  graph.weights_and_size_bounded
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
abbrev GWk (g : WeightedGraph) (l : List Nat) : Prop :=
  List.Chain' (fun u v => ∃ w, g.has_edge u v w) l

def gEdgeW (g : WeightedGraph) (u v : Nat) : Int :=
  (((g.adj.getD u #[]).toList.find? (fun p => p.1 = v)).map Prod.snd).getD 0

def gwt (g : WeightedGraph) : List Nat → Int
  | [] => 0
  | [_] => 0
  | u :: v :: rest => gEdgeW g u v + gwt g (v :: rest)

def collect {α β : Type} (f : α → List β) : List α → List β
  | [] => []
  | a :: t => f a ++ collect f t

def enumPaths (g : WeightedGraph) : Nat → List Nat → Nat → Int → List (Nat × Int)
  | 0, _, u, acc => [(u, acc)]
  | fuel + 1, vis, u, acc =>
      (u, acc) :: collect (fun p =>
          if p.1 ∈ u :: vis then [] else enumPaths g fuel (u :: vis) p.1 (acc + p.2))
        ((g.adj.getD u #[]).toList)

def minOpt : List Int → Option Int
  | [] => none
  | x :: xs => some (xs.foldr min x)

def distOf (entries : List (Nat × Int)) (v : Nat) : Option Int :=
  minOpt ((entries.filter (fun p => p.1 = v)).map Prod.snd)

def buildList (f : Nat → Option Int) : Nat → List (Option Int)
  | 0 => []
  | k + 1 => f 0 :: buildList (fun i => f (i + 1)) k
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def dijkstra_shortest_paths (graph : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat)
    (h_precond : dijkstra_shortest_paths_precond graph start) : List (Option Int) :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  buildList (fun v => distOf (enumPaths graph graph.size [] start 0) v) graph.size
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def dijkstra_shortest_paths_postcond (graph : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat)
    (result : List (Option Int))
    (_ : dijkstra_shortest_paths_precond graph start) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  result.length = graph.size ∧
  ∀ v, v < graph.size →
    match result.getD v none with
    | some d => graph.is_shortest_dist start v d
    | none => ¬ ∃ p, graph.is_path p ∧ p.head? = some start ∧ p.getLast? = some v
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
-- basic list helpers

lemma buildList_length (f : Nat → Option Int) (n : Nat) : (buildList f n).length = n := by
  induction n generalizing f with
  | zero => simp [buildList]
  | succ k ih => simp [buildList, ih]

lemma buildList_getD (f : Nat → Option Int) (n : Nat) :
    ∀ v, v < n → (buildList f n).getD v none = f v := by
  induction n generalizing f with
  | zero => intro v hv; exact absurd hv (by omega)
  | succ k ih =>
    intro v hv
    by_cases h0 : v = 0
    · subst h0
      show (f 0 :: buildList (fun i => f (i + 1)) k).getD 0 none = f 0
      simp
    · obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j, v = j + 1 := ⟨v - 1, by omega⟩
      subst hj
      show (f 0 :: buildList (fun i => f (i + 1)) k).getD (j + 1) none = f (j + 1)
      rw [List.getD_cons_succ]
      exact ih (fun i => f (i + 1)) j (by omega)

lemma mem_collect {α β : Type} (f : α → List β) (l : List α) (b : β) :
    b ∈ collect f l ↔ ∃ a ∈ l, b ∈ f a := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [collect]
  | cons a t ih => simp [collect, ih]

lemma glast_cons2 {α : Type} (a b : α) (t : List α) :
    (a :: b :: t).getLast? = (b :: t).getLast? := by
  first
  | rfl
  | simp

lemma getLast?_snoc {α : Type} (l : List α) (a : α) : (l ++ [a]).getLast? = some a := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons b t ih =>
    cases t with
    | nil => simp
    | cons c t' =>
      have e1 : (b :: c :: t') ++ [a] = b :: c :: (t' ++ [a]) := rfl
      have e2 : (c :: t') ++ [a] = c :: (t' ++ [a]) := rfl
      rw [e1, glast_cons2]
      rw [e2] at ih
      exact ih

lemma head?_eq {α : Type} (P : List α) (u : α) (h : P.head? = some u) : ∃ t, P = u :: t := by
  cases P with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons a t =>
    have : a = u := by simpa using h
    exact ⟨t, by rw [this]⟩

lemma snoc_of_getLast? {α : Type} :
    ∀ (l : List α) (u : α), l.getLast? = some u → ∃ A, l = A ++ [u] := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro u h; simp at h
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro u h
    cases t with
    | nil =>
      have : a = u := by simpa using h
      exact ⟨[], by rw [this]⟩
    | cons b t' =>
      rw [glast_cons2] at h
      obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := ih u h
      exact ⟨a :: A, by rw [hA]; rfl⟩

lemma getD_cz (x : Nat) (L : List Nat) : (x :: L).getD 0 0 = x := by
  first | rfl | simp

lemma getD_cs (x : Nat) (L : List Nat) (i : Nat) : (x :: L).getD (i + 1) 0 = L.getD i 0 := by
  first | rfl | simp

lemma arrMem {α : Type} (a : α) (as : Array α) : a ∈ as ↔ a ∈ as.toList := by
  first
  | simp
  | exact Array.mem_def

lemma nodup_length_le (P : List Nat) (n : Nat) (h1 : P.Nodup) (h2 : ∀ x ∈ P, x < n) :
    P.length ≤ n := by
  have hsub : P ⊆ List.range n := fun x hx => List.mem_range.mpr (h2 x hx)
  have h3 : P.length ≤ (List.range n).length :=
    List.Subperm.length_le (List.Nodup.subperm h1 hsub)
  simpa using h3

-- gwt equations

@[simp] lemma gwt_nil (g : WeightedGraph) : gwt g [] = 0 := by
  first | rfl | simp [gwt]

@[simp] lemma gwt_single (g : WeightedGraph) (a : Nat) : gwt g [a] = 0 := by
  first | rfl | simp [gwt]

@[simp] lemma gwt_cons2 (g : WeightedGraph) (a b : Nat) (t : List Nat) :
    gwt g (a :: b :: t) = gEdgeW g a b + gwt g (b :: t) := by
  first | rfl | simp [gwt]

-- GWk helpers

lemma GWk_nil (g : WeightedGraph) : GWk g [] := List.chain'_nil

lemma GWk_single (g : WeightedGraph) (a : Nat) : GWk g [a] := List.chain'_singleton a

lemma GWk_cons2_iff (g : WeightedGraph) (a b : Nat) (t : List Nat) :
    GWk g (a :: b :: t) ↔ (∃ w, g.has_edge a b w) ∧ GWk g (b :: t) := List.chain'_cons

lemma GWk_append_iff (g : WeightedGraph) (l1 l2 : List Nat) :
    GWk g (l1 ++ l2) ↔
      GWk g l1 ∧ GWk g l2 ∧ ∀ x ∈ l1.getLast?, ∀ y ∈ l2.head?, ∃ w, g.has_edge x y w :=
  List.chain'_append

lemma GWk_trunc (g : WeightedGraph) (A : List Nat) (v : Nat) (B : List Nat)
    (h : GWk g (A ++ v :: B)) : GWk g (A ++ [v]) := by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := (GWk_append_iff g A (v :: B)).mp h
  refine (GWk_append_iff g A [v]).mpr ⟨h1, GWk_single g v, ?_⟩
  intro x hx y hy
  have hyv : y = v := by simpa using hy
  subst hyv
  exact h3 x hx y (by simp)

lemma GWk_snoc (g : WeightedGraph) (P : List Nat) (u v : Nat) (w : Int)
    (hP : GWk g P) (hl : P.getLast? = some u) (he : g.has_edge u v w) : GWk g (P ++ [v]) := by
  refine (GWk_append_iff g P [v]).mpr ⟨hP, GWk_single g v, ?_⟩
  intro x hx y hy
  rw [hl] at hx
  have hxu : x = u := by simpa using hx
  have hyv : y = v := by simpa using hy
  subst hxu; subst hyv
  exact ⟨w, he⟩

-- edge weight facts

lemma hasEdge_iff (g : WeightedGraph) (u v : Nat) (w : Int) (hu : u < g.size) :
    g.has_edge u v w ↔ (v, w) ∈ (g.adj.getD u #[]).toList := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨-, pair, hmem, h1, h2⟩ := h
    have hp : pair = (v, w) := by
      first
      | exact Prod.ext_iff.mpr ⟨h1, h2⟩
      | (cases pair; simp_all)
    rw [← hp]
    exact (arrMem pair _).mp hmem
  · intro h
    exact ⟨hu, (v, w), (arrMem (v, w) _).mpr h, rfl, rfl⟩

lemma edgeW_eq (g : WeightedGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed) (u v : Nat) (w : Int)
    (h : g.has_edge u v w) : gEdgeW g u v = w := by
  obtain ⟨hu, pair, hmem, h1, h2⟩ := h
  have hml : pair ∈ (g.adj.getD u #[]).toList := (arrMem pair _).mp hmem
  unfold gEdgeW
  cases hf : (g.adj.getD u #[]).toList.find? (fun p => p.1 = v) with
  | none =>
    have hcon := List.find?_eq_none.mp hf pair hml
    simp [h1] at hcon
  | some q =>
    have hq1 : q ∈ (g.adj.getD u #[]).toList := List.mem_of_find?_eq_some hf
    have hq2 : q.1 = v := by
      have h3 := List.find?_some hf
      simpa using h3
    have huniq : q = pair :=
      (hwf u hu).2 q pair ((arrMem q _).mpr hq1) hmem (by rw [hq2, h1])
    simp [huniq, h2]

lemma gEdgeW_nonneg (g : WeightedGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed) (hnn : g.weights_non_negative)
    (u v : Nat) (h : ∃ w, g.has_edge u v w) : 0 ≤ gEdgeW g u v := by
  have hnn' : ∀ a b c, g.has_edge a b c → c ≥ 0 := hnn
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := h
  rw [edgeW_eq g hwf u v w hw]
  exact hnn' u v w hw

lemma nodes_lt (g : WeightedGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed) :
    ∀ (P : List Nat) (s : Nat), GWk g P → P.head? = some s → s < g.size →
      ∀ x ∈ P, x < g.size := by
  intro P
  induction P with
  | nil => intro s _ _ _ x hx; simp at hx
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro s hP hh hs x hx
    have ha : a = s := by simpa using hh
    subst ha
    cases t with
    | nil =>
      have : x = a := by simpa using hx
      subst this
      exact hs
    | cons b t' =>
      obtain ⟨⟨w, he⟩, hc⟩ := (GWk_cons2_iff g a b t').mp hP
      have hb : b < g.size := by
        obtain ⟨ha', pair, hmem, h1, -⟩ := he
        have h4 := (hwf a ha').1 pair hmem
        rw [h1] at h4
        exact h4
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with h | h
      · subst h; exact hs
      · exact ih b hc (by simp) hb x h

lemma gwt_nonneg (g : WeightedGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed) (hnn : g.weights_non_negative) :
    ∀ P : List Nat, GWk g P → 0 ≤ gwt g P := by
  intro P
  induction P with
  | nil => intro _; simp
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro hP
    cases t with
    | nil => simp
    | cons b t' =>
      obtain ⟨he, hc⟩ := (GWk_cons2_iff g a b t').mp hP
      have h1 := gEdgeW_nonneg g hwf hnn a b he
      have h2 := ih hc
      rw [gwt_cons2]
      linarith

-- path weight bridging

lemma phw_nil (g : WeightedGraph) (d : Int) : g.path_has_weight [] d ↔ d = 0 := by
  first | rfl | simp [WeightedGraph.path_has_weight]

lemma phw_single (g : WeightedGraph) (a : Nat) (d : Int) : g.path_has_weight [a] d ↔ d = 0 := by
  first | rfl | simp [WeightedGraph.path_has_weight]

lemma phw_cons2 (g : WeightedGraph) (a b : Nat) (t : List Nat) (d : Int) :
    g.path_has_weight (a :: b :: t) d ↔
      ∃ we wr, g.has_edge a b we ∧ g.path_has_weight (b :: t) wr ∧ d = we + wr := by
  first | rfl | simp [WeightedGraph.path_has_weight]

lemma phw_of_GWk (g : WeightedGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed) :
    ∀ P : List Nat, GWk g P → g.path_has_weight P (gwt g P) := by
  intro P
  induction P with
  | nil => intro _; rw [phw_nil]; simp
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro hP
    cases t with
    | nil => rw [phw_single]; simp
    | cons b t' =>
      obtain ⟨⟨w, hw⟩, hc⟩ := (GWk_cons2_iff g a b t').mp hP
      rw [phw_cons2]
      refine ⟨gEdgeW g a b, gwt g (b :: t'), ?_, ih hc, ?_⟩
      · have he : gEdgeW g a b = w := edgeW_eq g hwf a b w hw
        rw [he]; exact hw
      · rw [gwt_cons2]

lemma phw_unique (g : WeightedGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed) :
    ∀ (P : List Nat) (d : Int), g.path_has_weight P d → GWk g P ∧ d = gwt g P := by
  intro P
  induction P with
  | nil =>
    intro d h
    rw [phw_nil] at h
    exact ⟨GWk_nil g, by simp [h]⟩
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro d h
    cases t with
    | nil =>
      rw [phw_single] at h
      exact ⟨GWk_single g a, by simp [h]⟩
    | cons b t' =>
      rw [phw_cons2] at h
      obtain ⟨we, wr, he, hr, hd⟩ := h
      obtain ⟨hc, hwr⟩ := ih wr hr
      refine ⟨(GWk_cons2_iff g a b t').mpr ⟨⟨we, he⟩, hc⟩, ?_⟩
      rw [gwt_cons2, edgeW_eq g hwf a b we he, hd, hwr]

lemma isPath_GWk (g : WeightedGraph) : ∀ P : List Nat, g.is_path P → GWk g P := by
  intro P
  induction P with
  | nil => intro _; exact GWk_nil g
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro h
    obtain ⟨hlen, hedge⟩ := h
    cases t with
    | nil => exact GWk_single g a
    | cons b t' =>
      refine (GWk_cons2_iff g a b t').mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · have h0 := hedge 0 (by simp only [List.length_cons]; omega)
        rw [getD_cz, getD_cs, getD_cz] at h0
        exact h0
      · refine ih ⟨by simp, ?_⟩
        intro i hi
        have h1 := hedge (i + 1) (by simp only [List.length_cons] at hi ⊢; omega)
        rw [getD_cs, getD_cs] at h1
        exact h1

lemma GWk_isPath (g : WeightedGraph) : ∀ P : List Nat, GWk g P → P ≠ [] → g.is_path P := by
  intro P
  induction P with
  | nil => intro _ h; exact absurd rfl h
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro hP _
    cases t with
    | nil =>
      refine ⟨by simp, ?_⟩
      intro i hi
      simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_nil] at hi
      omega
    | cons b t' =>
      obtain ⟨⟨w, hw⟩, hc⟩ := (GWk_cons2_iff g a b t').mp hP
      obtain ⟨-, hip2⟩ := ih hc (by simp)
      refine ⟨by simp, ?_⟩
      intro i hi
      by_cases h0 : i = 0
      · subst h0
        rw [getD_cz, getD_cs, getD_cz]
        exact ⟨w, hw⟩
      · obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j, i = j + 1 := ⟨i - 1, by omega⟩
        subst hj
        rw [getD_cs, getD_cs]
        have hi' : j + 1 < (b :: t').length := by
          simp only [List.length_cons] at hi ⊢; omega
        exact hip2 j hi'

-- enumeration equations

lemma enumPaths_zero (g : WeightedGraph) (vis : List Nat) (u : Nat) (acc : Int) :
    enumPaths g 0 vis u acc = [(u, acc)] := by
  first | rfl | simp [enumPaths]

lemma enumPaths_succ (g : WeightedGraph) (fuel : Nat) (vis : List Nat) (u : Nat) (acc : Int) :
    enumPaths g (fuel + 1) vis u acc =
      (u, acc) :: collect (fun p =>
          if p.1 ∈ u :: vis then [] else enumPaths g fuel (u :: vis) p.1 (acc + p.2))
        ((g.adj.getD u #[]).toList) := by
  first | rfl | simp [enumPaths]

lemma enum_complete (g : WeightedGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed) :
    ∀ (fuel : Nat) (P vis : List Nat) (u : Nat) (acc : Int) (v : Nat),
      GWk g P → P.head? = some u → P.Nodup → (∀ x ∈ P, x ∉ vis) →
      P.length ≤ fuel + 1 → P.getLast? = some v →
      (v, acc + gwt g P) ∈ enumPaths g fuel vis u acc := by
  intro fuel
  induction fuel with
  | zero =>
    intro P vis u acc v hW hh hnd hvis hlen hlast
    obtain ⟨t, hPt⟩ := head?_eq P u hh
    subst hPt
    cases t with
    | nil =>
      have hv : u = v := by simpa using hlast
      subst hv
      rw [enumPaths_zero]
      simp
    | cons b t' =>
      simp only [List.length_cons] at hlen
      omega
  | succ fuel ih =>
    intro P vis u acc v hW hh hnd hvis hlen hlast
    obtain ⟨t, hPt⟩ := head?_eq P u hh
    subst hPt
    cases t with
    | nil =>
      have hv : u = v := by simpa using hlast
      subst hv
      rw [enumPaths_succ]
      simp
    | cons b t' =>
      obtain ⟨⟨w, hw⟩, hc⟩ := (GWk_cons2_iff g u b t').mp hW
      have hE : gEdgeW g u b = w := edgeW_eq g hwf u b w hw
      have hnd2 := List.nodup_cons.mp hnd
      have hbne : b ∉ u :: vis := by
        intro hcon
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hcon with h1 | h1
        · exact hnd2.1 (by simp [h1])
        · exact hvis b (by simp) h1
      have hvis2 : ∀ x ∈ (b :: t'), x ∉ u :: vis := by
        intro x hx hcon
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hcon with h1 | h1
        · rw [h1] at hx; exact hnd2.1 hx
        · exact hvis x (List.mem_cons_of_mem u hx) h1
      have hlen2 : (b :: t').length ≤ fuel + 1 := by
        simp only [List.length_cons] at hlen ⊢; omega
      have hlast2 : (b :: t').getLast? = some v := by
        rw [← hlast]
        exact (glast_cons2 u b t').symm
      have hmem := ih (b :: t') (u :: vis) b (acc + w) v hc (by simp) hnd2.2 hvis2 hlen2 hlast2
      have hwtEq : acc + gwt g (u :: b :: t') = acc + w + gwt g (b :: t') := by
        rw [gwt_cons2, hE]; ring
      rw [enumPaths_succ]
      refine List.mem_cons_of_mem _ ?_
      rw [mem_collect]
      refine ⟨(b, w), (hasEdge_iff g u b w hw.1).mp hw, ?_⟩
      show (v, acc + gwt g (u :: b :: t')) ∈
        (if b ∈ u :: vis then ([] : List (Nat × Int))
          else enumPaths g fuel (u :: vis) b (acc + w))
      rw [if_neg hbne, hwtEq]
      exact hmem

lemma enum_sound (g : WeightedGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed) :
    ∀ (fuel : Nat) (vis : List Nat) (u : Nat) (acc : Int) (v : Nat) (ω : Int),
      u < g.size → u ∉ vis → (v, ω) ∈ enumPaths g fuel vis u acc →
      ∃ P : List Nat, P.head? = some u ∧ P.getLast? = some v ∧ GWk g P ∧ P.Nodup ∧
        (∀ x ∈ P, x ∉ vis) ∧ ω = acc + gwt g P := by
  intro fuel
  induction fuel with
  | zero =>
    intro vis u acc v ω hu hvis hmem
    rw [enumPaths_zero] at hmem
    simp only [List.mem_singleton, Prod.mk.injEq] at hmem
    obtain ⟨hv, hω⟩ := hmem
    subst hv; subst hω
    exact ⟨[u], by simp, by simp, GWk_single g u, by simp, by simpa using hvis, by simp⟩
  | succ fuel ih =>
    intro vis u acc v ω hu hvis hmem
    rw [enumPaths_succ] at hmem
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hmem with h | h
    · simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at h
      obtain ⟨hv, hω⟩ := h
      subst hv; subst hω
      exact ⟨[u], by simp, by simp, GWk_single g u, by simp, by simpa using hvis, by simp⟩
    · rw [mem_collect] at h
      obtain ⟨p, hpL, hpm⟩ := h
      have hpm' : (v, ω) ∈
          (if p.1 ∈ u :: vis then ([] : List (Nat × Int))
            else enumPaths g fuel (u :: vis) p.1 (acc + p.2)) := hpm
      have hpe : g.has_edge u p.1 p.2 := (hasEdge_iff g u p.1 p.2 hu).mpr (by simpa using hpL)
      by_cases hin : p.1 ∈ u :: vis
      · rw [if_pos hin] at hpm'
        simp at hpm'
      · rw [if_neg hin] at hpm'
        have hp1lt : p.1 < g.size := (hwf u hu).1 p ((arrMem p _).mpr hpL)
        obtain ⟨P', hh', hl', hW', hnd', hvis', hω'⟩ :=

-- min facts

lemma foldr_min_mem : ∀ (xs : List Int) (x : Int), xs.foldr min x ∈ x :: xs := by
  intro xs
  induction xs with
  | nil => intro x; simp
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro x
    have h := ih x
    rcases le_total a (t.foldr min x) with hle | hle
    · rw [List.foldr_cons, min_eq_left hle]; simp
    · rw [List.foldr_cons, min_eq_right hle]
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp h with h1 | h1
      · rw [h1]; simp
      · simp [h1]

lemma foldr_min_le : ∀ (xs : List Int) (x y : Int), y ∈ x :: xs → xs.foldr min x ≤ y := by
  intro xs
  induction xs with
  | nil =>
    intro x y hy
    have : y = x := by simpa using hy
    simp [this]
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro x y hy
    rw [List.foldr_cons]
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hy with h1 | h1
    · have h2 := ih x x (by simp)
      have h3 : min a (t.foldr min x) ≤ t.foldr min x := min_le_right _ _
      rw [h1]
      linarith
    · rcases List.mem_cons.mp h1 with h2 | h2
      · rw [h2]; exact min_le_left _ _
      · have h3 := ih x y (List.mem_cons_of_mem x h2)
        have h4 : min a (t.foldr min x) ≤ t.foldr min x := min_le_right _ _
        linarith

lemma minOpt_nil : minOpt [] = none := by first | rfl | simp [minOpt]

lemma minOpt_cons (x : Int) (xs : List Int) : minOpt (x :: xs) = some (xs.foldr min x) := by
  first | rfl | simp [minOpt]

lemma minOpt_mem (l : List Int) (d : Int) (h : minOpt l = some d) : d ∈ l := by
  cases l with
  | nil => rw [minOpt_nil] at h; exact absurd h (by simp)
  | cons x xs =>
    rw [minOpt_cons] at h
    have hd : xs.foldr min x = d := by simpa using h
    rw [← hd]
    exact foldr_min_mem xs x

lemma minOpt_le (l : List Int) (x : Int) (h : x ∈ l) : ∃ d, minOpt l = some d ∧ d ≤ x := by
  cases l with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons a t => exact ⟨t.foldr min a, minOpt_cons a t, foldr_min_le t a x h⟩

lemma mem_dl (entries : List (Nat × Int)) (v : Nat) (d : Int) :
    d ∈ (entries.filter (fun p => p.1 = v)).map Prod.snd ↔ (v, d) ∈ entries := by
  simp only [List.mem_map, List.mem_filter, decide_eq_true_eq]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨p, ⟨hp, hp1⟩, hp2⟩
    have hpe : p = (v, d) := by
      first
      | exact Prod.ext_iff.mpr ⟨hp1, hp2⟩
      | (cases p; simp_all)
    rw [← hpe]; exact hp
  · intro h
    exact ⟨(v, d), ⟨h, rfl⟩, rfl⟩

lemma distOf_mem (entries : List (Nat × Int)) (v : Nat) (d : Int)
    (h : distOf entries v = some d) : (v, d) ∈ entries :=
  (mem_dl entries v d).mp (minOpt_mem _ _ h)

lemma distOf_le (entries : List (Nat × Int)) (v : Nat) (ω : Int) (h : (v, ω) ∈ entries) :
    ∃ d, distOf entries v = some d ∧ d ≤ ω := by
  have h1 : ω ∈ (entries.filter (fun p => p.1 = v)).map Prod.snd := (mem_dl entries v ω).mpr h
  obtain ⟨d, hd1, hd2⟩ := minOpt_le _ _ h1
  exact ⟨d, hd1, hd2⟩

-- gwt append facts

lemma gwt_split (g : WeightedGraph) (v : Nat) (B : List Nat) :
    ∀ A : List Nat, gwt g (A ++ v :: B) = gwt g (A ++ [v]) + gwt g (v :: B) := by
  intro A
  induction A with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a A' ih =>
    cases A' with
    | nil =>
      show gwt g (a :: v :: B) = gwt g (a :: [v]) + gwt g (v :: B)
      rw [gwt_cons2, gwt_cons2]
      simp
    | cons a2 A'' =>
      show gwt g (a :: a2 :: (A'' ++ v :: B)) =
        gwt g (a :: a2 :: (A'' ++ [v])) + gwt g (v :: B)
      have ih' : gwt g (a2 :: (A'' ++ v :: B)) =
          gwt g (a2 :: (A'' ++ [v])) + gwt g (v :: B) := ih
      rw [gwt_cons2, gwt_cons2, ih']
      ring

lemma gwt_snoc (g : WeightedGraph) (P : List Nat) (u v : Nat) (h : P.getLast? = some u) :
    gwt g (P ++ [v]) = gwt g P + gEdgeW g u v := by
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := snoc_of_getLast? P u h
  subst hA
  have h1 : (A ++ [u]) ++ [v] = A ++ u :: [v] := by simp
  rw [h1, gwt_split]
  simp

  obtain ⟨d, hd1, hd2⟩ := distOf_le _ v (0 + gwt g Q) hmem
  exact ⟨d, hd1, by linarith⟩

      ∃ we wr, g.has_edge a b we ∧ g.path_has_weight (b :: t) wr ∧ d = we + wr := by
  first | rfl | simp [WeightedGraph.path_has_weight]

lemma phw_of_GWk (g : WeightedGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed) :
    ∀ P : List Nat, GWk g P → g.path_has_weight P (gwt g P) := by
  intro P
  induction P with
  | nil => intro _; rw [phw_nil]; simp
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro hP
    cases t with
    | nil => rw [phw_single]; simp
    | cons b t' =>
      obtain ⟨⟨w, hw⟩, hc⟩ := (GWk_cons2_iff g a b t').mp hP
      rw [phw_cons2]
      refine ⟨gEdgeW g a b, gwt g (b :: t'), ?_, ih hc, ?_⟩
      · have he : gEdgeW g a b = w := edgeW_eq g hwf a b w hw
        rw [he]; exact hw
      · rw [gwt_cons2]

lemma phw_unique (g : WeightedGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed) :
    ∀ (P : List Nat) (d : Int), g.path_has_weight P d → GWk g P ∧ d = gwt g P := by
  intro P
  induction P with
  | nil =>
    intro d h
    rw [phw_nil] at h
    exact ⟨GWk_nil g, by simp [h]⟩
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro d h
    cases t with
    | nil =>
      rw [phw_single] at h
      exact ⟨GWk_single g a, by simp [h]⟩
    | cons b t' =>
      rw [phw_cons2] at h
      obtain ⟨we, wr, he, hr, hd⟩ := h
      obtain ⟨hc, hwr⟩ := ih wr hr
      refine ⟨(GWk_cons2_iff g a b t').mpr ⟨⟨we, he⟩, hc⟩, ?_⟩
      rw [gwt_cons2, edgeW_eq g hwf a b we he, hd, hwr]

lemma isPath_GWk (g : WeightedGraph) : ∀ P : List Nat, g.is_path P → GWk g P := by
  intro P
  induction P with
  | nil => intro _; exact GWk_nil g
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro h
    obtain ⟨hlen, hedge⟩ := h
    cases t with
    | nil => exact GWk_single g a
    | cons b t' =>
      refine (GWk_cons2_iff g a b t').mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · have h0 := hedge 0 (by simp only [List.length_cons]; omega)
        rw [getD_cz, getD_cs, getD_cz] at h0
        exact h0
      · refine ih ⟨by simp, ?_⟩
        intro i hi
        have h1 := hedge (i + 1) (by simp only [List.length_cons] at hi ⊢; omega)
        rw [getD_cs, getD_cs] at h1
        exact h1

lemma GWk_isPath (g : WeightedGraph) : ∀ P : List Nat, GWk g P → P ≠ [] → g.is_path P := by
  intro P
  induction P with
  | nil => intro _ h; exact absurd rfl h
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro hP _
    cases t with
    | nil =>
      refine ⟨by simp, ?_⟩
      intro i hi
      simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_nil] at hi
      omega
    | cons b t' =>
      obtain ⟨⟨w, hw⟩, hc⟩ := (GWk_cons2_iff g a b t').mp hP
      obtain ⟨-, hip2⟩ := ih hc (by simp)
      refine ⟨by simp, ?_⟩
      intro i hi
      by_cases h0 : i = 0
      · subst h0
        rw [getD_cz, getD_cs, getD_cz]
        exact ⟨w, hw⟩
      · obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j, i = j + 1 := ⟨i - 1, by omega⟩
        subst hj
        rw [getD_cs, getD_cs]
        have hi' : j + 1 < (b :: t').length := by
          simp only [List.length_cons] at hi ⊢; omega
        exact hip2 j hi'

-- enumeration equations

lemma enumPaths_zero (g : WeightedGraph) (vis : List Nat) (u : Nat) (acc : Int) :
    enumPaths g 0 vis u acc = [(u, acc)] := by
  first | rfl | simp [enumPaths]

lemma enumPaths_succ (g : WeightedGraph) (fuel : Nat) (vis : List Nat) (u : Nat) (acc : Int) :
    enumPaths g (fuel + 1) vis u acc =
      (u, acc) :: collect (fun p =>
          if p.1 ∈ u :: vis then [] else enumPaths g fuel (u :: vis) p.1 (acc + p.2))
        ((g.adj.getD u #[]).toList) := by
  first | rfl | simp [enumPaths]

lemma enum_complete (g : WeightedGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed) :
    ∀ (fuel : Nat) (P vis : List Nat) (u : Nat) (acc : Int) (v : Nat),
      GWk g P → P.head? = some u → P.Nodup → (∀ x ∈ P, x ∉ vis) →
      P.length ≤ fuel + 1 → P.getLast? = some v →
      (v, acc + gwt g P) ∈ enumPaths g fuel vis u acc := by
  intro fuel
  induction fuel with
  | zero =>
    intro P vis u acc v hW hh hnd hvis hlen hlast
    obtain ⟨t, hPt⟩ := head?_eq P u hh
    subst hPt
    cases t with
    | nil =>
      have hv : u = v := by simpa using hlast
      subst hv
      rw [enumPaths_zero]
      simp
    | cons b t' =>
      simp only [List.length_cons] at hlen
      omega
  | succ fuel ih =>
    intro P vis u acc v hW hh hnd hvis hlen hlast
    obtain ⟨t, hPt⟩ := head?_eq P u hh
    subst hPt
    cases t with
    | nil =>
      have hv : u = v := by simpa using hlast
      subst hv
      rw [enumPaths_succ]
      simp
    | cons b t' =>
      obtain ⟨⟨w, hw⟩, hc⟩ := (GWk_cons2_iff g u b t').mp hW
      have hE : gEdgeW g u b = w := edgeW_eq g hwf u b w hw
      have hnd2 := List.nodup_cons.mp hnd
      have hbne : b ∉ u :: vis := by
        intro hcon
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hcon with h1 | h1
        · exact hnd2.1 (by simp [h1])
        · exact hvis b (by simp) h1
      have hvis2 : ∀ x ∈ (b :: t'), x ∉ u :: vis := by
        intro x hx hcon
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hcon with h1 | h1
        · rw [h1] at hx; exact hnd2.1 hx
        · exact hvis x (List.mem_cons_of_mem u hx) h1
      have hlen2 : (b :: t').length ≤ fuel + 1 := by
        simp only [List.length_cons] at hlen ⊢; omega
      have hlast2 : (b :: t').getLast? = some v := by
        rw [← hlast]
        exact (glast_cons2 u b t').symm
      have hmem := ih (b :: t') (u :: vis) b (acc + w) v hc (by simp) hnd2.2 hvis2 hlen2 hlast2
      have hwtEq : acc + gwt g (u :: b :: t') = acc + w + gwt g (b :: t') := by
        rw [gwt_cons2, hE]; ring
      rw [enumPaths_succ]
      refine List.mem_cons_of_mem _ ?_
      rw [mem_collect]
      refine ⟨(b, w), (hasEdge_iff g u b w hw.1).mp hw, ?_⟩
      show (v, acc + gwt g (u :: b :: t')) ∈
        (if b ∈ u :: vis then ([] : List (Nat × Int))
          else enumPaths g fuel (u :: vis) b (acc + w))
      rw [if_neg hbne, hwtEq]
      exact hmem

lemma base_sound (g : WeightedGraph) (u : Nat) (vis : List Nat) (acc : Int) (v : Nat) (ω : Int)
    (hvis : u ∉ vis) (hv : v = u) (hω : ω = acc) :
    ∃ P : List Nat, P.head? = some u ∧ P.getLast? = some v ∧ GWk g P ∧ P.Nodup ∧
      (∀ x ∈ P, x ∉ vis) ∧ ω = acc + gwt g P := by
  refine ⟨[u], by simp, by simp [hv], GWk_single g u, by simp, by simpa using hvis, by simp [hω]⟩

lemma enum_sound (g : WeightedGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed) :
    ∀ (fuel : Nat) (vis : List Nat) (u : Nat) (acc : Int) (v : Nat) (ω : Int),
      u < g.size → u ∉ vis → (v, ω) ∈ enumPaths g fuel vis u acc →
      ∃ P : List Nat, P.head? = some u ∧ P.getLast? = some v ∧ GWk g P ∧ P.Nodup ∧
        (∀ x ∈ P, x ∉ vis) ∧ ω = acc + gwt g P := by
  intro fuel
  induction fuel with
  | zero =>
    intro vis u acc v ω hu hvis hmem
    rw [enumPaths_zero] at hmem
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hmem with h | h
    · have hv : v = u := congrArg Prod.fst h
      have hω : ω = acc := congrArg Prod.snd h
      exact base_sound g u vis acc v ω hvis hv hω
    · exact absurd h (by simp)
  | succ fuel ih =>
    intro vis u acc v ω hu hvis hmem
    rw [enumPaths_succ] at hmem
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hmem with h | h
    · have hv : v = u := congrArg Prod.fst h
      have hω : ω = acc := congrArg Prod.snd h
      exact base_sound g u vis acc v ω hvis hv hω
    · rw [mem_collect] at h
      obtain ⟨p, hpL, hpm⟩ := h
      have hpm' : (v, ω) ∈
          (if p.1 ∈ u :: vis then ([] : List (Nat × Int))
            else enumPaths g fuel (u :: vis) p.1 (acc + p.2)) := hpm
      have hpe : g.has_edge u p.1 p.2 := (hasEdge_iff g u p.1 p.2 hu).mpr (by simpa using hpL)
      by_cases hin : p.1 ∈ u :: vis
      · rw [if_pos hin] at hpm'
        simp at hpm'
      · rw [if_neg hin] at hpm'
        have hp1lt : p.1 < g.size := (hwf u hu).1 p ((arrMem p _).mpr hpL)
        obtain ⟨P', hh', hl', hW', hnd', hvis', hω'⟩ :=
          ih (u :: vis) p.1 (acc + p.2) v ω hp1lt hin hpm'
        obtain ⟨t', hP'⟩ := head?_eq P' p.1 hh'
        subst hP'
        refine ⟨u :: p.1 :: t', by simp, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [glast_cons2]; exact hl'
        · exact (GWk_cons2_iff g u p.1 t').mpr ⟨⟨p.2, hpe⟩, hW'⟩
        · refine List.nodup_cons.mpr ⟨?_, hnd'⟩
          intro hcon
          exact hvis' u hcon (by simp)
        · intro x hx
          rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with h1 | h1
          · subst h1; exact hvis
          · intro hcon
            exact hvis' x h1 (by simp [hcon])
        · rw [gwt_cons2, edgeW_eq g hwf u p.1 p.2 hpe, hω']
          ring

-- min facts

lemma foldr_min_mem : ∀ (xs : List Int) (x : Int), xs.foldr min x ∈ x :: xs := by
  intro xs
  induction xs with
  | nil => intro x; simp
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro x
    have h := ih x
    rcases le_total a (t.foldr min x) with hle | hle
    · rw [List.foldr_cons, min_eq_left hle]; simp
    · rw [List.foldr_cons, min_eq_right hle]
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp h with h1 | h1
      · rw [h1]; simp
      · simp [h1]

lemma foldr_min_le : ∀ (xs : List Int) (x y : Int), y ∈ x :: xs → xs.foldr min x ≤ y := by
  intro xs
  induction xs with
  | nil =>
    intro x y hy
    have hyx : y = x := by simpa using hy
    simp [hyx]
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro x y hy
    rw [List.foldr_cons]
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hy with h1 | h1
    · have h2 := ih x x (by simp)
      have h3 : min a (t.foldr min x) ≤ t.foldr min x := min_le_right _ _
      rw [h1]
      linarith
    · rcases List.mem_cons.mp h1 with h2 | h2
      · rw [h2]; exact min_le_left _ _
      · have h3 := ih x y (List.mem_cons_of_mem x h2)
        have h4 : min a (t.foldr min x) ≤ t.foldr min x := min_le_right _ _
        linarith

lemma minOpt_nil : minOpt [] = none := by first | rfl | simp [minOpt]

lemma minOpt_cons (x : Int) (xs : List Int) : minOpt (x :: xs) = some (xs.foldr min x) := by
  first | rfl | simp [minOpt]

lemma minOpt_mem (l : List Int) (d : Int) (h : minOpt l = some d) : d ∈ l := by
  cases l with
  | nil => rw [minOpt_nil] at h; exact absurd h (by simp)
  | cons x xs =>
    rw [minOpt_cons] at h
    have hd : xs.foldr min x = d := by simpa using h
    rw [← hd]
    exact foldr_min_mem xs x

lemma minOpt_le (l : List Int) (x : Int) (h : x ∈ l) : ∃ d, minOpt l = some d ∧ d ≤ x := by
  cases l with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons a t => exact ⟨t.foldr min a, minOpt_cons a t, foldr_min_le t a x h⟩

lemma mem_dl (entries : List (Nat × Int)) (v : Nat) (d : Int) :
    d ∈ (entries.filter (fun p => p.1 = v)).map Prod.snd ↔ (v, d) ∈ entries := by
  simp only [List.mem_map, List.mem_filter, decide_eq_true_eq]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨p, ⟨hp, hp1⟩, hp2⟩
    have hpe : p = (v, d) := by
      first
      | exact Prod.ext_iff.mpr ⟨hp1, hp2⟩
      | (cases p; simp_all)
    rw [← hpe]; exact hp
  · intro h
    exact ⟨(v, d), ⟨h, rfl⟩, rfl⟩

lemma distOf_mem (entries : List (Nat × Int)) (v : Nat) (d : Int)
    (h : distOf entries v = some d) : (v, d) ∈ entries :=
  (mem_dl entries v d).mp (minOpt_mem _ _ h)

lemma distOf_le (entries : List (Nat × Int)) (v : Nat) (ω : Int) (h : (v, ω) ∈ entries) :
    ∃ d, distOf entries v = some d ∧ d ≤ ω := by
  have h1 : ω ∈ (entries.filter (fun p => p.1 = v)).map Prod.snd := (mem_dl entries v ω).mpr h
  obtain ⟨d, hd1, hd2⟩ := minOpt_le _ _ h1
  exact ⟨d, hd1, hd2⟩

-- gwt append facts

lemma gwt_split (g : WeightedGraph) (v : Nat) (B : List Nat) :
    ∀ A : List Nat, gwt g (A ++ v :: B) = gwt g (A ++ [v]) + gwt g (v :: B) := by
  intro A
  induction A with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a A' ih =>
    cases A' with
    | nil =>
      show gwt g (a :: v :: B) = gwt g (a :: [v]) + gwt g (v :: B)
      rw [gwt_cons2, gwt_cons2]
      simp
    | cons a2 A'' =>
      show gwt g (a :: a2 :: (A'' ++ v :: B)) =
        gwt g (a :: a2 :: (A'' ++ [v])) + gwt g (v :: B)
      have ih' : gwt g (a2 :: (A'' ++ v :: B)) =
          gwt g (a2 :: (A'' ++ [v])) + gwt g (v :: B) := ih
      rw [gwt_cons2, gwt_cons2, ih']
      ring

lemma gwt_snoc (g : WeightedGraph) (P : List Nat) (u v : Nat) (h : P.getLast? = some u) :
    gwt g (P ++ [v]) = gwt g P + gEdgeW g u v := by
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := snoc_of_getLast? P u h
  subst hA
  have h1 : (A ++ [u]) ++ [v] = A ++ u :: [v] := by simp
  rw [h1, gwt_split]
  simp

-- distance facts

lemma dist_le_of_path (g : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat) (hwf : g.well_formed)
    (hs : start < g.size) (Q : List Nat) (v : Nat) (hW : GWk g Q)
    (hh : Q.head? = some start) (hl : Q.getLast? = some v) (hnd : Q.Nodup) :
    ∃ d, distOf (enumPaths g g.size [] start 0) v = some d ∧ d ≤ gwt g Q := by
  have hlt : ∀ x ∈ Q, x < g.size := nodes_lt g hwf Q start hW hh hs
  have hlen : Q.length ≤ g.size := nodup_length_le Q g.size hnd hlt
  have hmem := enum_complete g hwf g.size Q [] start 0 v hW hh hnd (by simp) (by omega) hl
  obtain ⟨d, hd1, hd2⟩ := distOf_le _ v (0 + gwt g Q) hmem
  exact ⟨d, hd1, by linarith⟩

lemma dist_edge (g : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat) (hwf : g.well_formed)
    (hnn : g.weights_non_negative) (hs : start < g.size)
    (u v : Nat) (w : Int) (he : g.has_edge u v w) (du : Int)
    (hdu : distOf (enumPaths g g.size [] start 0) u = some du) :
    ∃ dv, distOf (enumPaths g g.size [] start 0) v = some dv ∧ dv ≤ du + w := by
  have hnn' : ∀ a b c, g.has_edge a b c → c ≥ 0 := hnn
  have hw0 : 0 ≤ w := hnn' u v w he
  have hmem := distOf_mem _ u du hdu
  obtain ⟨P, hh, hl, hW, hnd, -, hω⟩ :=
    enum_sound g hwf g.size [] start 0 u du hs (by simp) hmem
  have hdu' : du = gwt g P := by simpa using hω
  by_cases hvP : v ∈ P
  · obtain ⟨A, B, hAB⟩ := List.append_of_mem hvP
    have hWP : GWk g (A ++ v :: B) := by rw [← hAB]; exact hW
    have hWQ : GWk g (A ++ [v]) := GWk_trunc g A v B hWP
    have hWvB : GWk g (v :: B) := ((GWk_append_iff g A (v :: B)).mp hWP).2.1
    have hndAB : (A ++ v :: B).Nodup := by rw [← hAB]; exact hnd
    obtain ⟨hndA, hvA⟩ := nodup_split A v B hndAB
    have hndQ : (A ++ [v]).Nodup := nodup_snoc A v hndA hvA
    have hhQ : (A ++ [v]).head? = some start := by
      rw [hAB] at hh
      cases A with
      | nil => simpa using hh
      | cons a A' => simpa using hh
    have hlQ : (A ++ [v]).getLast? = some v := getLast?_snoc A v
    have hsplit : gwt g P = gwt g (A ++ [v]) + gwt g (v :: B) := by
      rw [hAB]; exact gwt_split g v B A
    have hnonneg : 0 ≤ gwt g (v :: B) := gwt_nonneg g hwf hnn (v :: B) hWvB
    obtain ⟨d, hd1, hd2⟩ := dist_le_of_path g start hwf hs (A ++ [v]) v hWQ hhQ hlQ hndQ
    exact ⟨d, hd1, by linarith⟩
  · have hWQ : GWk g (P ++ [v]) := GWk_snoc g P u v w hW hl he
    have hndQ : (P ++ [v]).Nodup := nodup_snoc P v hnd hvP
    have hhQ : (P ++ [v]).head? = some start := by
      obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := head?_eq P start hh
      rw [ht]; simp
    have hlQ : (P ++ [v]).getLast? = some v := getLast?_snoc P v
    have hwtQ : gwt g (P ++ [v]) = gwt g P + gEdgeW g u v := gwt_snoc g P u v hl
    have hEw : gEdgeW g u v = w := edgeW_eq g hwf u v w he
    obtain ⟨d, hd1, hd2⟩ := dist_le_of_path g start hwf hs (P ++ [v]) v hWQ hhQ hlQ hndQ
    rw [hwtQ, hEw] at hd2
    exact ⟨d, hd1, by linarith⟩

lemma dist_start (g : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat) (hwf : g.well_formed)
    (hs : start < g.size) :
    ∃ d0, distOf (enumPaths g g.size [] start 0) start = some d0 ∧ d0 ≤ 0 := by
  obtain ⟨d, hd1, hd2⟩ :=
    dist_le_of_path g start hwf hs [start] start (GWk_single g start) (by simp) (by simp)
      (by simp)
  exact ⟨d, hd1, by simpa using hd2⟩

lemma propagate (g : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat) (hwf : g.well_formed)
    (hnn : g.weights_non_negative) (hs : start < g.size) :
    ∀ (P : List Nat) (u t : Nat) (du : Int), GWk g P → P.head? = some u →
      P.getLast? = some t → distOf (enumPaths g g.size [] start 0) u = some du →
      ∃ dt, distOf (enumPaths g g.size [] start 0) t = some dt ∧ dt ≤ du + gwt g P := by
  intro P
  induction P with
  | nil => intro u t du _ hh _ _; simp at hh
  | cons a L ih =>
    intro u t du hW hh hl hdu
    have hau : a = u := by simpa using hh
    subst hau
    cases L with
    | nil =>
      have hat : a = t := by simpa using hl
      subst hat
      exact ⟨du, hdu, by simp⟩
    | cons b L' =>
      obtain ⟨⟨w, hw⟩, hc⟩ := (GWk_cons2_iff g a b L').mp hW
      obtain ⟨db, hdb1, hdb2⟩ := dist_edge g start hwf hnn hs a b w hw du hdu
      have hlb : (b :: L').getLast? = some t := by
        rw [← hl]; exact (glast_cons2 a b L').symm
      obtain ⟨dt, hdt1, hdt2⟩ := ih b t db hc (by simp) hlb hdb1
      refine ⟨dt, hdt1, ?_⟩
      have hE : gEdgeW g a b = w := edgeW_eq g hwf a b w hw
      rw [gwt_cons2, hE]
      linarith
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem dijkstra_shortest_paths_postcond_satisfied (graph : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat)
    (h_precond : dijkstra_shortest_paths_precond graph start) :
    dijkstra_shortest_paths_postcond graph start
      (dijkstra_shortest_paths graph start h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  have hwf : graph.well_formed := h_precond.1
  have hs : start < graph.size := h_precond.2.1
  have hnn : graph.weights_non_negative := h_precond.2.2.1
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · show (buildList (fun v => distOf (enumPaths graph graph.size [] start 0) v)
      graph.size).length = graph.size
    exact buildList_length _ _
  · intro v hv
    show (match (buildList (fun x => distOf (enumPaths graph graph.size [] start 0) x)
        graph.size).getD v none with
      | some d => graph.is_shortest_dist start v d
      | none => ¬ ∃ p, graph.is_path p ∧ p.head? = some start ∧ p.getLast? = some v)
    rw [buildList_getD _ _ v hv]
    cases hd : distOf (enumPaths graph graph.size [] start 0) v with
    | none =>
      show ¬ ∃ p, graph.is_path p ∧ p.head? = some start ∧ p.getLast? = some v
      rintro ⟨p, hp, hph, hpl⟩
      have hW : GWk graph p := isPath_GWk graph p hp
      obtain ⟨d0, hd01, hd02⟩ := dist_start graph start hwf hs
      obtain ⟨dt, hdt1, -⟩ := propagate graph start hwf hnn hs p start v d0 hW hph hpl hd01
      rw [hd] at hdt1
      exact absurd hdt1 (by simp)
    | some d =>
      show graph.is_shortest_dist start v d
      have hmem := distOf_mem _ v d hd
      obtain ⟨P, hh, hl, hW, hnd, -, hω⟩ :=
        enum_sound graph hwf graph.size [] start 0 v d hs (by simp) hmem
      have hdP : d = gwt graph P := by simpa using hω
      constructor
      · refine ⟨P, GWk_isPath graph P hW ?_, hh, hl, ?_⟩
